About Us

Rajkot's Most Trusted Water Partner

Traditional RO Water is a leading manufacturer and service provider of advanced water purification systems in Rajkot, Gujarat. We deliver end-to-end solutions for industrial, commercial, and residential needs.

With 5+ years of expertise, we specialize in turnkey projects offering quality, durability, and innovation in every system we build.

Our Services

Complete Water Solutions

From home RO to large industrial water treatment plants — we do it all.

🔩
RO Installation
Home and office RO purifier installation with complete testing and handover.
🔧
Repair & Maintenance

Custom RO plant design & turnkey execution from 2000 to 12000 LPH capacity.

Annual AMC
Hassle-free annual maintenance contracts for homes, offices and industries.
💧

Complete water treatment — softeners, DM plants, UV, ozone and filtration.
